text:
maria: Auditor requested compact SOC2/ISO evidence: RBAC changes (last 90d) + approvals, filtered audit logs, KMS rotation manifest + decrypt verification, and any incident triage tied to role changes.

sam: Confirming 90 days OK. I'll extract role diffs + PR/ticket links.

auditor: Please include mapping (control->artifact), MD5 checksum, and brief sampling rationale for logs.

alex: I'll export Splunk filtered CSV (role-change + assume-role) and produce a 1hr replay sample. Splunk query: index=infra (action=UpdateRole OR action=AssumeRole) | table _time,user,action,roleName,requestId

jess: Redaction policy: replace emails with uid:XXXX, include a mapping file. No private keys or unredacted ciphertexts.

maria: Include incident INT-321 (2025-06-11) where CI attempted UpdateRole and failed MFA. Need timeline, responder names, mitigation steps, confirmation keys not exfiltrated. Oncall lead note ok.

oncall-bot: @maria assigned INT-321 to maria, due 2025-07-10.

maria: Plan to produce tarball evidence_bundle_2025-07-09.tar.gz with crosswalk.csv, rbac_diffs.csv, approval_artifacts/, logs/, kms/rotation_manifest.txt, kms/decrypt_tests.txt, incident/INT-321.md, README.md (redaction + sampling + checksums).

sam: I'll include scripts used to generate diffs so auditor can verify process.

auditor: Thanks. Please upload to SFTP and ping when ready.
